notes.title: Dangerous City Escape 1.11A Patch Description
notes.content:
1. Modified the mental point consumption mode, now changing to running mode where 10 MP is consumed per second. After being out of running mode for 3 seconds, it restores 20 MP points per second.
2. Using a knife increases MP consumption to 8 points, pistol consumption to 5 points, and shotgun consumption to 10 points.
3. The recovery value of cigarettes has been increased to 40 points, alcohol has been increased to 50 points, and mineral water has been increased to 20 points.
4. Fixed some bugs with text misalignment.

notes.title: Update instructions for version 1.01c
notes.content:
1. The focus has been on enhancing the keyboard key settings. Originally, there was no keyboard key scheme set, but now the default key setting scheme has been changed. If necessary, each button can be customized and modified.
2. Added handle control and added a default setting for handle settings (currently tested using PS4 handles).
3. Modified the priority of key settings during military training. Now it's time to set the buttons first and then conduct military training.
4. Changed the mode for players to experience electric shock when walking into a puddle on the rooftop, and now the first time they step into a puddle, they will automatically retreat.
5. Modified the prompt for the 304 key after completing the 304 branch task and opening the access control.
6. Modified the situation where store dialogue windows are too frequent.

notes.title: Update Instructions
notes.content:
1. Added teaching guidelines for training in the game, and now instructors will remind and redisplay the tutorial when not equipped with weapons.
2. The tutorial display has been optimized for the situation where the tutorial ends too quickly. Now, after forcing to watch the tutorial for 3 seconds, press the button to skip the tutorial.
3. Modify one food item in room 301302 to cigarettes.
4. The game fixed a bug at the entrance of Room 102 that had a certain chance of getting stuck, and fixed a bug of explosives.
